meta.description: Third held-out GMPP set for ProjectLens (2013-14 -> 2014-15, 2014-15 -> 2015-16, 2015-16 -> 2016-17, plus one 2020-21 -> 2021-22 pair). Not for tuning.
meta.yearConvention: year N = the release labelled (N-1)-N. Releases up to 2019-20 report data as at 30 September of year N-1; 2020-21 onwards as at 31 March of year N.

labelRules.contradiction: end date moved >14 days and the narrative says unchanged/the same/on track/on schedule, or names a current end date >14 days from the published one, without stating the actual move
labelRules.explained: end date moved >14 days and the narrative states the change (or the delay/reset that caused it)
labelRules.no-move: published end date identical in both releases (daysMoved = 0) and the narrative does not name a different current end date
labelRules.published-date-check: published end date identical in both releases, but the narrative names a current end date >14 days from the published one

contradictionTypes.claims-unchanged: unchanged / remain unchanged / no deviation / will not impact the end date
contradictionTypes.claims-on-track: 'on track' / 'on schedule' / 'in line with plan' with no move stated
contradictionTypes.names-different-date: names a current end date >14 days from the published one

meta.matching: Releases before 2019-20 publish no GMPP ID. Pairs are joined on the exact project name after lower-casing and stripping punctuation, only when unique in both releases. The one 2021-22 pair is joined on GMPP ID.
meta.narrativeVerbatim: Exact cell text from the current-release CSV, including line breaks.

cases.project: General Practice System of Choice (GPSoC) Replacement
cases.narrative:
The original Project End Date for the General Practice System of Choice Replacement Project was 31/03/15.  An extension was requested and approved to extend the End Date to 31/10/15.
A seven month extension was required because:
• Supplier delays have impacted the delivery of Entry and Standard Requirements within required operational service dates.  
• Suppliers are late in the delivery of General Practice System of Choice  Services specifically against Principal Clinical System and National Services (Summary Care Record and GP2GP) Requirements.  
• Current General Practice System of Choice  Interface Mechanism pairing process has been limited due to delayed delivery of Principal Interface Management requirements, assurance of Subsidiary Supplier systems and the evolvement of supporting processes and test environments.  This in turn may impact the ability to deliver Subsidiary Supplier pairings.
• Programme and Commercial resource shortage is impacting the ability to deliver commissioned projects.

The Programme is aiming for the project to move into Business As Usual following the approval our the Project Closure Report by the end of the financial year 2015/16.
cases.label: published-date-check
cases.why: Published end date unchanged (31 Mar 2015 in both releases). The narrative says 'An extension was requested and approved to extend the End Date to 31/10/15', which is 7 months later than the column.
cases.matchedBy: exact project name (case and punctuation normalised), unique in both releases
